backend.command:
python3 -c "import importlib, sys; from pathlib import Path; module = importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1][:-3].replace('/', '.')); payload, receipt = module.apply(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes())
with Path(sys.argv[3]).open('xb') as output:
    output.write(payload)
print(receipt)" mod_editor/core/nfl2k5_roster_storage.py <source.xbe> <new-copy.xbe>

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Opt-in witness disc only; off in every preset.

input_constraints: Pinned USA retail executable or a recognized composed stack with the complete owner union reserved.
All 82 original stadium records must be present in the loaded ROST. This is not a custom stadium importer.
Reserves remain limited to 12, teams to their existing records. No larger reserve or team save schema is implemented.
portme: Run the stadium preview, controller wrap, Create a Team, game-load and signed-save witnesses in ASTRA_STORAGE_GROWTH_REPORT.md.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Static instruction and byte-reference audits, complete owner composition and host save round trips. No native game execution, preview or save lifecycle witness.

fields.allowed: false in Basic, Advanced and Experimental; explicit opt-in only

selectors.notes: Implies xbe_space and adds nfl2k5_roster_storage.REQUESTS to the full owner union before first growth.
